title: lonicera involucrata
intro: Lonicera involucrata, commonly known as the beach honeysuckle, is a flowering plant native to the Pacific Northwest region of North America. The beach honeysuckle has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Lonicera involucrata include its antiseptic and antiviral properties, which can aid in the treatment of various infections and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
